snp5.9:1.4: when anyone explained ‘It is,’ ‘It will be,’
snp5.9:1.5:
all that was hearsay,
quotation marks.
snp5.9:2.2:
teach me the Dhamma
demolishing craving,
snp5.9:2.4:
one would cross over beyond
entanglement in the world.
snp5.9:3.3:
—seen, heard, sensed, & cognized—
there is:
the dispelling of passion & desire,
snp5.9:3.4: the unfallen, undying state of unbinding.
snp5.9:4.1:
Those knowing this, mindful,
fully unbound
snp5.9:4.4:
have crossed over beyond
entanglement in the world.
